text:
Plumber in Ellenbrook fixes a tap for AUD$400.

Two years later the same family books him for a new hot water system. Then the bathroom reno.

That AUD$400 customer was worth thousands.

Work out what one customer is worth over a few years. Then decide if SEO is expensive.

Electrician in Cannington. Homepage headline: "Powering Tomorrow's Solutions."

(Solid headline right there.)

Nowhere does it say "electrician" or Cannington.

Someone searches "electrician Cannington" and Google has nothing to match.

Say what you do and where, in plain words.

Earn a spot on the Google map and your competitor can't buy it off you.

Google says there's no way to pay for a better local ranking.

That's why SEO is worth the slow start.

Four checks to see if it suits your business:
